metadata.tower_config: Each tower has 2B + Ground + 13 Floors (per DWG title block). Units are categorized by floor range: Ground, Ground+Even, First, First+Odd, Second+Even, Third+Odd, etc.
extraction_notes: Floor plan type labels and floor ranges extracted from MTEXT/TEXT entities in SALE UNIT 17-06-26.dwg
Tower elevations and floor labels extracted from 3.SITE & TOWER TENDER 04-05-26 - Copy.dwg
Image filenames parsed to map each flat on each tower to its corresponding floor plan image
Tower A Flat-01 Ground+Even uses the file labeled 'Ground+ODD' in the Even folder (filename has a typo - this 4BHK image is used for A-Flat-01 on both even and odd floors per DWG)
Tower B 'Odd' folder contains the same Even-floor plans (typical floor plan repeats on odd floors)
Tower D Flat-04 Ground+Even image is not provided — using the First+Odd 4BHK image as substitute

summary.explanation: Each tower has G+13 floors = 14 floor levels where apartments exist. 21 unique flat types × 14 floors = 294 apartments. The 47 unit_plan_mappings cover every (flat × floor_range) combo where the floor plan changes — a single flat may use different plans on different floor ranges.
